title: An exponential two-way deterministic state lower bound for one-way liveness
summary: OpenAI 数学仓库收录的研究手稿。展开查看英文摘要，或标记后让我进一步解释。
status: AI 产生的研究手稿；收录不表示已完成独立审查或同行评议。
abstractEnglish: One-way liveness on h points accepts a word of binary relations when their ordered product is nonempty. For every h ≥ 2, it has a nondeterministic automaton with $`h+3`$ states and no left moves, whereas every equivalent s-state two-way deterministic automaton satisfies $`4(s+2)^2\ge2^{\lfloor(h-2)/31\rfloor}`$. Partial transition rules, stay moves, and nonaccepting infinite computations are allowed. The alphabets are finite and grow with h, so the result rules out an alphabet-independent polynomial state bound for deterministic two-way simulation, already for one-way nondeterministic sources.
titleEn: An exponential two-way deterministic state lower bound for one-way liveness
titleZh: 单向活性问题的指数双向确定状态下界

details.overview: 该稿件研究单向活性语言在双向确定自动机下的状态复杂度。h点上的单向活性接受有序乘积非空的二元关系词。作者声称：对每个h≥2，存在h+3个状态且无左移的非确定自动机；而任何等价s状态双向确定自动机满足4(s+2)²≥2^{⌊(h−2)/31⌋}。摘要允许部分转移规则、停留移动与非接受无限计算，字母表随h增长，因此排除字母表无关的多项式状态界。
keyPoints: 声称单向活性有h+3状态无左移非确定自动机
证明等价双向确定自动机状态数满足指数下界
